svg.title: react-trace-compare
svg.desc: Four prompting modes on the same two-hop question: (a) standard prompting answers directly; (b) chain-of-thought reasons without acting; (c) act-only issues tool actions and reads observations without thoughts; (d) ReAct interleaves thoughts with actions and observations. Generic placeholder entities A, B and X. Script-drawn schematic: layout, text and icons are generated by build.py as vector shapes (no bitmaps, no AI-generated icons).

g.text: Same question in all four panels:
a two-hop question that needs one fact about A and one about B
